create_dataset_instance: create a VisionTactileBackboneDataset instance with a DictConfig, dataset name, and sensor type for tactile data loading
get_dataset_item: get a single training item from the VisionTactileBackboneDataset by index with optional flip, crop, and rotation augmentations
load_tactile_images: load and preprocess tactile images from a pickle dataset with resize, flip, crop, and rotation transforms
configure_output_format: configure the dataset output format as video, concatenated channel image, or single image via the out_format config option
plot_tactile_clip: plot a tactile clip visualization saving frames as a tactile_clip.png image file for debugging
